title: THE POMEGRANATE HOUR, 3 AM · title page
venue: the motel · the lobby TV at 3 AM · recaps never run · Box 13
logline: The title page, drawn before page one: the masthead over the series' one image, with nobody in it. It letters the title, the subtitle and the tagline. A channel the motel doesn't get.

panels.composition: The lobby TV on its bracket filling the page, the screen a rounded rectangle in the one spot-tone blue, on it the title card: the script title with a cut pomegranate for the O of HOUR, its seeds the only red on the page, 3 AM in clock digits beneath, and under the bracket the motel's desk bell and the empty desk.

image.prompt: razor-sharp black ink comic page with a blue spot tone, a wall-mounted lobby television filling the frame with a rounded screen showing a late-night talk-show title card with a cut pomegranate in place of one letter, a clock reading 3 AM beneath, and below the bracket an empty motel desk with a bell
image.notes: A channel the motel doesn't get. The seeds are the only red the series allows.
